text:
Alice: :warning: Seeing rapid OOMs on eu-west-1 dedicated-gpu cluster (pool-dedicated-eu0). Mem pressure -> eviction -> nodes draining. Noted ~95% utilized for last 15m.
Miguel: Any early signals? autoscaler logs?
Alice: Autoscaler attempted scale but API rate-limited by provider, then got 5 spot-evictions in a minute. Autoscaler reverted to 0->2 retries, then failed. Logs:
```
2026-11-12T14:04:12Z ERROR autoscaler: scale_up failed: RateLimitExceeded
2026-11-12T14:04:56Z WARN node-manager: spot eviction, reclaiming pods
2026-11-12T14:05:21Z ERROR scheduler: insufficient resources for batch jobs
```
Sophia: Oof. Are we still honoring dedicated-only routing for customers with reserved contracts?
Ryan: Yes, routing policy for 'dedicated' tier pins requests to pool-dedicated-eu0 unless capacity < 10% free. That threshold crossed ~14:03 UTC.
Infra Bot: Automated health alert: cluster pool-dedicated-eu0 degraded -> eviction rate 0.37/s, avg-p99-latency +120ms, fallback eligible = true.
Jess: Are requests currently being failed or redirected? Any 5xx spikes?
Alice: Both. A small fraction are 429s from quota controller, most new requests are queued then hit timeout or redirected silently to hosted-api (per fallback policy). We saw a slow surge in hosted usage.
Miguel: Silent redirect is intended but we didn't notify CostOps or customers. CostOps, heads up, hosted cost will spike if we keep redirecting.
CostOps: Confirmed. Notified finance slack channel. Please estimate delta before continuing with mass redirects.
Ryan: Quick plan options: 1) Evacuate non-critical batch jobs and free up GPUs (low-impact), 2) Force immediate routing cutoff to hosted with announce (fast), 3) Try to claim new reserved nodes (slow, provider cooldown). I suggest 1 + 2.
Sophia: Agree with 1+2. Evacuate and throttle batch priority jobs first. Can we patch priority config?
Alice: Patching now: lowering batch job priorities and bumping preemption flag. Command run:
```
kubectl label jobs --selector=job-type=batch priority=low
autoscale set --pool pool-dedicated-eu0 --min 2 --max 6
```
Miguel: Starting evacuation script to move non-prod jobs out of eu0 -> staging pools. Script output: moved 42 jobs, freed ~8 GPUs.
Infra Bot: Evacuation complete: freed 8 GPUs, pool utilization -> 84%.
Jess: We're still seeing request backlog for latency-sensitive routes. Need immediate partial redirect to hosted for low-SLA customers, keep enterprise pinned to dedicated if possible.
Ryan: Implemented routing change: updated routing policy to mark customers with tag "enterprise-sla:true" as pin=true; all others get hostable=true. Pushed config: `routeset v29`.
Alice: Confirming: % of traffic to hosted jumped from 4% -> 38% after change. Observability dashboards updated.
CostOps: Noted hosted token estimate +42% for the hour. Please open a cost mitigation ticket if this persists.
Sophia: We should also enable short-lived quantization on hosted to lower token cost for redirected flows. Is that possible quickly?
Miguel: Can do a runtime override: `model=quant-lite` for redirected traffic. Doing hot patch.
Alice: Hot patch applied. Initial latency looks ok. Need to watch correctness regressions.
Ryan: Action items: (A) follow up with sales/customer-success to inform affected customers; (B) schedule capacity reprovisioning with cloud provider; (C) draft post-incident note for oncall; (D) CostOps to track spend.
Jess: Oncall taking postmortem. @Ryan @Sophia please own rollback criteria: if hosted error rate >2% or model regressions >X, revert routing and throttle.
Sophia: Agreed. Setting regression alert: eval set 'smoke-e2e' run every 5m on redirected traffic.
Infra Bot: Alert registered: smoke-e2e failure threshold 3 consecutive fails -> page oncall.
Alice: Current status update: dedicated pool stabilized at 78-86% after evacuation, hosted absorbing overflow with quant-lite. No customer-visible errors for enterprise pinned.
Miguel: I'll start provider support ticket requesting emergent capacity + spot protection for the pool. ETA vendor says 4-6m for confirmations, full provisioning 20-30m.
CostOps: Estimate for 30m spike ~ $6k extra if continued. Let us know if you need emergency approval to continue redirecting beyond 30m.
Jess: Logged incident ticket and tagged SRE lead. We'll keep the channel updated. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
